title: Running Races & Endurance Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=raceresult:event) OR (index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="raceresult:event","primary",sourcetype="trainingpeaks:workout","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from raceresult:event and trainingpeaks:workout to see whether two running races feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `raceresult:event` and `trainingpeaks:workout` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main running races data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
